sentences.en: Luciano Pavarotti - Famed opera singer; passed away at age 71 on September 6 from pancreatic cancer.

sentences.en: He was absolutely mesmerised by Pavarotti on television.

sentences.en: Pavarotti is a unique performer with the Midas touch.

sentences.en: With a smock artfully covering his paunchy frame, Pavarotti, 56(sentencedict.com), burst into golden-toned song.

sentences.en: Pavarotti will be appearing in a number of concerts over the summer.
